name: swarajya-mcp
description: Search, fetch, and explore Swarajya magazine articles directly from Claude.
long_description: Read-only access to swarajyamag.com via the Quintype public API. Includes tools for full-text search, fetching articles with their body as clean markdown, listing recent stories by section, browsing authors and editorial collections, and discovering the site taxonomy.

tools.name: swarajya_search_stories
tools.description: Faceted search across all Swarajya articles.

tools.name: swarajya_get_story
tools.description: Fetch a single article with body as markdown.

tools.name: swarajya_list_recent_stories
tools.description: List most recent stories, optionally by section.

tools.name: swarajya_list_authors
tools.description: Author directory with name filter and pagination.
